lines: Inside the safe, you also find an old photo. An architect.
Elias Thorne. The man who designed the dam.
The back of the photo has three marks, drawn in order: a house, an arch, a gear.

m1.text: Thorne never trusted Ardis's father. He left a backdoor in the dam's control system.

m2.text: The spillway terminal will not take a typed word. It wants the marks on the back of Thorne's photo, in the order he drew them.

g1.text: Open the cloud to access Thorne's terminal.

mg1.title: Thorne's Key

config.brief: Set the three marks from the photo, in the order they were drawn. The terminal reads itself. You do not type the word.

hints: The key is the marks, not a word you spell.
When the key is right, the panel reads TRAITOR.

lines: The marks lock in. House. Arch. Gear.
The panel answers by itself: TRAITOR.
The control panel unlocks, revealing the detonation sequence.

m3.text: They set the timer. 2 hours until the valley floods.

m_evac.text: There's no time. The town's sirens have been disabled. Only you can stop it.

m4.text: You need to find the physical detonator. It's hidden in the old town hall archives.
